issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'ban Ngài làm đầu' (gave You as head) incorrectly identifies the subject/object relationship. The Greek 'αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν' means 'He [God] gave Him [Christ] as head'. The Vietnamese phrasing suggests He gave 'You' (the reader/listener), whereas the Greek refers to Christ.
